model_annotation: This pie chart details the distribution of categories related to approximate number generation, disjunctive and conjunctive concepts, and existential quantification. The chart contains seven slices, each representing a distinct category. Starting from the leftmost slice and proceeding clockwise, these are: “Negation” in a reddish-orange color representing 27.91%, “Universal Quantifiers” in a light blue color representing 29.07%, “Comparative Relationships” in a seafoam green color representing 36.26%, “Approximate Quantities” in a yellow color representing 45.03%, “Disjunctive” in a lavender color representing 49.51%, “Conjunctive” in a pinkish-purple color representing 50.49%, and “Existential Quantifiers” in a light pink color representing 15.12%, and finally "Limiter" in a light green color representing 27.91%, and "Absolute Absence" in a rose color representing 18.71%. Percentage labels are included inside each slice, and a legend identifying each category and its corresponding color is present. The segments do not appear to be ordered in any particular visual manner.
